output.findings:
Based on 2026 estimates, Cairo is the most populous of the three cities with 23.2 million, followed by Lagos with 21.9 million, and Kinshasa with 16.9 million.

While specific, universally agreed-upon annual percentage growth rates for these exact cities in 2024/2025 vary by source, Lagos is widely documented as one of the fastest-growing cities in Africa, with recent reports estimating its annual growth rate at approximately 3.3%.

Kinshasa is also characterized by extremely high urban growth, frequently cited as one of the fastest-growing megacities globally. Cairo, while still growing, generally exhibits a lower annual growth rate compared to the rapid, often infrastructure-straining expansion seen in Lagos and Kinshasa. Among the three, Lagos and Kinshasa are growing significantly faster than Cairo, with Lagos frequently highlighted for its high-velocity expansion.

| **Kinshasa** | ~16.9M – 21.85M | Highest growth rate (~5.13%) |
